description: This C# source file defines a static class `OpenSourceInitializer` which initializes certain components and replaces placeholders with default behaviors in a Unity project utilizing Vuforia. It sets default configurations for game objects, replaces placeholder objects with actual component handlers, and contains internal nested classes implementing specific interfaces for attaching default behaviors.

classes.name: OpenSourceInitializer
classes.description: A static class responsible for initializing default behaviors and replacing placeholders with actual components in a Unity scene for Vuforia integration.

classes.name: DefaultBehaviourAttacher
classes.description: Internal class implementing `IDefaultBehaviourAttacher`, adding default trackable and initialization error handler components to game objects.

methods.name: OpenSourceInitializer
methods.description: Static constructor invoked on load, sets default behavior configuration and initiates placeholder replacements.

methods.name: ReplacePlaceHolders
methods.description: Locates placeholder objects in the scene and replaces them with their respective default behavior components.
